description: "Poems by Fanny Kemble" is a collection of poetry written by Frances Anne Butler, also known as Fanny Kemble, in the mid-19th century. This volume showcases a range of themes including nature, love, sorrow, and the complexity of human emotions, reflecting the literary style and sensibilities of the Romantic era.
